title: Pune startup develops atomic clock prototype amid growing export curbs on critical technologies
summary: Atomic clocks are critical to satellite navigation, telecommunications, space missions and strategic systems, where highly precise and stable timekeeping is essential.
llm_summary: A Pune‑based startup has built a prototype atomic clock—a device that keeps time with extreme precision, which is essential for GPS, telecom networks, space missions and other strategic systems. The effort comes as India tightens export controls on critical technologies, prompting domestic firms to develop home‑grown alternatives. This breakthrough could help secure the country’s high‑tech infrastructure while reducing reliance on foreign suppliers.
